projects.name: Timewizer
projects.description: Standalone desktop app for building school timetables, with teacher substitutions, cover sheets, undo/redo and Excel/CSV export.

projects.name: Orbit
projects.description: Connect, browse, back up and mount your cloud storage with wizards and plain-language screens. Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, SFTP and network shares.

projects.name: Stingray
projects.tagline: Your folders, cloud drives and servers in one window.
projects.description: A clean, modern file manager with Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox built in, plus SMB, SFTP and NFS network drives. Tabs and split view, archive browsing, undo/redo, a built-in terminal and a preview panel, plus Empty Trash, package install and password-protected archives.

projects.name: Burn It!
projects.tagline: Make bootable USB drives from any ISO.
projects.description: Writes Linux and Windows ISOs to USB from either operating system. Built with Tauri (Rust + web UI).

projects.name: Graphite Mail
projects.tagline: Offline mail and calendar for Linux.
projects.description: A native Linux client for Microsoft 365 mail and calendar via Microsoft Graph.

projects.name: Madrasa
projects.description: Offline-capable school administration: students, attendance, exams, fees and finance, teachers, reports and backups, plus transport, hostel, inventory and directory login. Works offline and syncs when the server is back, with an Android parent app and user manuals in English and Urdu. Alpha, for testers only.

projects.name: Rabita
projects.tagline: Join Linux to your domain, the friendly way.
projects.description: A setup wizard that joins Linux desktops to an Active Directory domain: work login, network drives and printers. The setup wizard and an installable .deb are built; no release yet.

projects.name: Lobster Browser
projects.description: Built on Firefox ESR with ad and tracker blocking, privacy defaults and a calm new-tab page. A private built-in AI agent is planned. First preview, Linux only.

projects.name: SkyPop
projects.tagline: Pop the balls, clear ten stages.
projects.description: A colourful Pang-inspired arcade game: ten illustrated stages, three rope styles, weapon upgrades, an illustrated story, optional global scoreboard and gamepad support. Built with Godot.

projects.name: Teamux
projects.tagline: Microsoft Teams, made to work on Linux and Windows.
projects.description: An unofficial Microsoft Teams desktop client with native Wayland, PipeWire screen sharing and camera support on Linux, a video studio with skin smoothing, and an adaptive network guardian for weak branch-office links. Now also on Windows. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

projects.name: The Last Pocket
projects.description: A cue-sports game: ten pool, snooker and carom modes, local two-player, AI rivals and a comic-style championship. Source is Apache-2.0; the bundled music is licensed for use inside the game only.

projects.name: Nudge
projects.description: A 3D pinball game built with Godot: three tables so far, Cosmic Drift (deep space), Paradise Bay (island) and Alpenglow (Swiss castle), with more planned. Keyboard and controller, local top ten.

projects.name: Dangal
projects.tagline: A 2D fighting game set in Pakistan.
projects.description: An arcade fighter with two fighters, Rustam of Karachi and Baba Sher of Hunza, two animated stages, full voice acting, ultra moves and breakable props. Made with Godot.

projects.name: Firebreak
projects.description: An Operation Wolf-style gallery shooter: hold your position as the battlefield pans across a river village, shoot enemies, spare the villagers, buy weapons. Early development build, stage 1 of twelve.

projects.name: Darsgah
projects.tagline: Online classes that work on weak internet.
projects.description: A low-bandwidth online classroom for schools, built on Jitsi: a server and a simple desktop client for Linux and Windows. Design stage, no release yet.
